correctness.rationale: Consistent periodic P1 assembly gives H=4I+S+S^-1, A=(4+6r)I+(1-3r)(S+S^-1), and P=2A^-1 H-I. At r=0 identity, r=1/3 nonnegative, at n>=4 and 0<r<1/3 the signed cyclic inverse yields positive G_02 and P_02=-36rG_02/(1-3r)<0. At r>1/3 inverse is positive Stieltjes, so offdiagonals >0 and diagonal f_n(r) strictly decreases, with unique zero rho_n. Exact positive finite-size Green correction decreases in n and proves rho_n↓(5+sqrt(33))/12; n=3 direct eigenmode formula gives r<=1. Independent full P matrices and Fourier sums in 99 n/r cases, roots for n3..13, corroborate.
residual_risks: No monotone positivity claim for nonuniform/Dirichlet FEM or finite precision; r=0 is isolated for n>=4.

value.rationale: The natural periodic consistent-mass heat discretization has a nontrivial *nonmonotone* allowed timestep set: no small positive step, then a precisely quantified positivity window. Identifies the sharp finite-grid endpoint, its strict mesh monotonicity and limit, improving a conventional sufficient 2/3 limit.
